# TommyOS: Tommy Roldan, Miami Web Developer & Designer

> Freelance web developer and designer based in Miami, Florida, building websites,
> e-commerce storefronts, iOS/Android apps, and custom AI agents for startups and
> small businesses. Shipping production work since 2015. Fluent in English and
> Spanish, and available for new projects.

Tommy Roldan works across four areas: fast marketing websites, e-commerce and
Shopify storefronts, cross-platform mobile apps built with React Native and Expo,
and custom AI agents and workflow automation. He also serves as CTO of TerryCo Group, NST Pharma, World Resort Rescue and
Clear Care Dental Group, and as Head of LATAM Sales at NST Pharma, which deals in
the Latin market a lot; he is Colombian and fluent in Spanish.

Typical stack: React, Next.js, Vite, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript, Node.js, React
Native, Expo, Shopify/Liquid, and Python.

The site is called TommyOS: the portfolio presented as a desktop operating system in the browser. On a computer it is a Mac-style desktop with windows, a dock, Launchpad and Spotlight; on a phone it is an iPhone-style home screen with pages and widgets. Every project is an app icon that opens a case file with the live site inside, and every page below is also a plain HTML route. The Games folder holds Armagetron (Armagetron Advanced, the light-cycles game, in the browser), Brick Breaker, Meme Maker and Paint, which includes Trace, a tracing game scored against free photos and line art. Visitors can change the wallpaper, and the last choice is what the next visitor sees.

## Pages

- [Home](https://tommyroldan.com/): Overview of services, featured projects, and a FAQ answering the most common questions about cost, timelines, and scope.
- [Work](https://tommyroldan.com/work/): Full portfolio: apps, web platforms, AI agents, tools, and archived early work.
- [About](https://tommyroldan.com/about/): Background, experience, and the story from Medellín to Miami.
- [Tools](https://tommyroldan.com/tools/): Free browser-based utilities built to solve real problems.
- [FAQ](https://tommyroldan.com/faq/): Cost, timelines, Shopify, apps, AI agents, Spanish, answered.
- [Contact](https://tommyroldan.com/contact/): Project inquiry form, the way to start a project.
- [Paint](https://tommyroldan.com/paint/): Draw and post to the public wall.
- [Brick Breaker](https://tommyroldan.com/brick-breaker/): The 2015 canvas game, playable.
- [Armagetron](https://tommyroldan.com/arena/): Armagetron Advanced in the browser, the light-cycles game Tommy grew up playing, built on the open-source Armawebtron port, real Armagetron rules (rubber, grinding), bots named after the estate agents, billboards for the apps on this site.
- [Trace](https://tommyroldan.com/paint/): Inside Paint: trace a photo or drawing under tracing paper; closer lines score higher, fewer tools on harder levels.
- [Meme Maker](https://tommyroldan.com/meme/): Follow MeMe revived: make a meme, post it, no sign-up.

## Products

- [AirDJ](https://tommyroldan.com/work/airdj/): Live audio broadcasting for mobile and traveling DJs, at https://airdj.vercel.app. Go live from any audio input and hand people a link or a QR code; they listen in the browser with no app and no account. Audio goes peer to peer over WebRTC and is never recorded. Next.js, React, Node.js, Socket.IO.
- [Canary](https://tommyroldan.com/canary/): Free Windows diagnostic tool that finds failing drives and crash causes that vendor software reports as healthy. Reads the SMART counters other tools skip, explains findings in plain English, and says "could not verify" rather than pretending a check passed.
- [PPT Speech](https://tommyroldan.com/ppt-speech/): Upload any .pptx and have it read aloud slide by slide using your browser's built-in voices. Runs entirely client-side: no server, no upload.

## Selected client work

- [WrapMe](https://wrapme.app): Real-time 3D configurator for vehicle wrap and paint shops. Customers orbit their own car in the browser and try real films across six independently painted zones, rendered live in WebGL.
- [Websites for wrap shops](https://tommyroldan.com/wrap-shop-websites/): Web design for vehicle wrap shops and wrap studios. A built-in 3D wrap configurator (WrapMe), a site the shop edits itself, booking that carries the customer's design, and search setup for Google and AI assistants.
- [Roldan Group](https://buildroldan.com): Site for a family exterior construction and remodelling business, including Pool Vision, an AI feature that previews the finished result on a homeowner's own property.
- [Clear Care Dental Group Web App](https://tommyroldan.com/work/clear-care-dental/): Case study. The member and provider portal at https://app.clearcaredentalgroup.com and the back office behind it: admin overview, support tickets, and a marketing blog manager that edits the public site through the GitHub API. Shares its backend with the iPhone app. React, Vite, Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL.
- [Clear Care Dental for iPhone](https://tommyroldan.com/work/clear-care-dental-ios/): Native SwiftUI member app, free on the App Store since 2026-09-30 (https://apps.apple.com/us/app/clear-care-dental/id6813132091), iOS 17 or later. Price check, X-ray second opinion (an automated reading, not a diagnosis), treatment plans, membership card, appointments and billing.
- [Clear Care Dental Group Website](https://tommyroldan.com/work/cleancare-marketing/): Conversion-focused marketing site at https://clearcaredentalgroup.com. React, Vite.
- [Clear Care Dental Enterprise](https://clearcaredentalenterprise.com/): Enterprise dashboard handling benefits administration, member management, and practice operations at scale.
- [Dolce Vita Supplements](https://www.dolcevitasupplements.com/): Shopify e-commerce brand for sublingual supplement strips, with editorial storefront design and a frictionless checkout.
- [Versatile Custom](https://versatilecustom.com): Site for a Miami vehicle wrap studio, built around the 3D visualizer I developed for the shop. Customers design their build in the browser, see the services (colour-change wraps, paint protection film, chrome delete, custom lighting and starlight headliners), then get in touch for a quote.
- [World Resort Rescue](https://worldresortrescue.com): Full redesign of a consumer-facing resort services site: rebuilt structure, clearer navigation, modern responsive front end.
- [Cuatro Group](https://cuatro-group.vercel.app/en): Multilingual corporate site, fully internationalized for a global audience.
- [NST Redesign](https://nst-redesign.vercel.app): Ground-up redesign of the NST Pharma site in React, Vite, and Tailwind.

- [Privacy Policy](https://tommyroldan.com/privacy.html): How data is collected, used, and protected across the tools on this site.

- [KOM Memorial](https://tommyroldan.com/work/kom-memorial/): Open-source web app for cyclists (MIT): log KOMs and memorialize lost ones. No Strava API. Source: https://github.com/TmasLove/kom-memorial
